messages:
jess: Heads-up — temporary per-team spend ceilings for mid-May hiring & holiday projects. TL;DR: teams can request a one-time temporary increase up to +20% for May; there's also an expedited vendor pre-approval flow for contracts under $50k. Please read and follow the process below. :spiral_calendar:

mike: Adding context — this is to cover short-term runway for expected seasonal infra and contractor needs, not ongoing headcount. Any raise must tie to an approved project brief or headcount exception. :eyes:

ana: Quick Q: how do we request the 20% bump? is it automatic for teams hitting threshold?

mike: Not automatic. Send a short request to procurement (see template). We'll fast-track approvals for requests that include: project brief link, expected spend timeline, justification, and the approver from the team. Example subject: `PROC: <Team>-TempSpend-May2026`

sanjay: Can confirm we have a hire in recruiting that would push infra spend — I'll submit. Do we need a PO first or after vendor sign?

mike: Submit a vendor-preapproval request before signing. If approved, procurement will issue a provisional PO within 48 hours for vendors <= $50k. For >$50k, follow the standard procurement cadence but we can prioritize.

proc-bot: New vendor request REQ-834 submitted by sanjay — status: queued for review. (You will get an update in ~24-48h)

jess: Important deadlines: requests for temporary ceilings must be submitted by 2026-05-01. Contracting that starts after 2026-06-01 will not be eligible for this one-time bump.

kate: For people ops — if this affects headcount or contractor conversion, ping me and cc your EM so we can coordinate approvals.

ana: Template from procurement (paste into email or ticket):
```
Subject: PROC: <Team>-TempSpend-May2026
Body:
- Project brief (link): <link>
- Requested ceiling increase: +XX% (amount)
- Expected spend window: <date> to <date>
- Primary approver: <name/email>
- Vendor(s): <name>, estimated amount
- GL code(s): <if known>
```

mike: Please include the preferred GL codes if you have them (common infra GL: `6003`, contractors: `5102`). If you can't find codes, procurement will slot temporarily and reconcile later.

sanjay: Submitted the request with project brief link and vendor estimate. REQ-834 notes attached. Thanks for the quick path.

proc-bot: REQ-834 status update: in review by procurement (mike, ana). Info request expected if missing docs.

jess: A couple of governance notes: 1) this bump is one-time and non-recurring, 2) any misuse (e.g., split purchases to bypass thresholds) will be rolled back and may trigger review.

ana: We'll publish a short FAQ in Confluence and a follow-up announcement on Monday with the request link and the intake form.

mike: If anyone needs help filling the template or needs GL mapping, DM me or drop into #finance-help. We'll also run a brief drop-in on Thurs 10am PT to walk teams through it. :calendar:
thread_summary: Temporary one-time per-team spend ceiling increase and expedited vendor pre-approval process for May projects; request template, deadlines, PO guidance, and governance notes.
